    Profile

    Daphne is a vice-captain of the Purple Flame Guard of the Indivia Belt. Nicknamed "The Shield Maiden", she is a highly respected figure in the area. However, she doesn't feel that she deserves such a title just yet. Her seriousness leads to an effort to better herself.

    Origin: Indivia Belt
    Gender: Female
    Height: 163cm
    Weight: 49kg
    Birthday: Sept 11
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Ice Water Wolf
    Likes: Nice people & time alone
    Hobbies: Getting new gear
    Illust: しぶ彦（G-ROW）
    CV: 佳穂成美
